/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
human=''
indri=''
sem=''
def lev(a,b):
 if len(a)<len(b):a,b=b,a
 prev=list(range(len(b)+1))
 for i,ca in enumerate(a,1):
  cur=[i]
  for j,cb in enumerate(b,1):
   cur.append(min(prev[j]+1,cur[-1]+1,prev[j-1]+(ca"'!=cb)))
  prev=cur
 return prev[-1]
print('"'lengths',len(indri),len(sem),len(human))
print('indri dist',lev(indri,human))
print('sem dist',lev(sem,human))
# verify simple alignment removal of extension? 
print('indri[9:] equals aligned sseq?',indri[9:]==indri)
print('sem[9:]',sem[:9],sem[9:]==sem)
PY"
